answer: Divergent-Response Challenge Registry.** Each identity must answer fresh, random challenges within a latency window; answers are checked against a shared secret only that identity's runtime state can produce. Clones sharing state harbor identical responses, exposing duplication. A genuine agent can sable its outputs with unique noise each round. To pass, an attacker must give each clone an independent voyage through challenge generation—costing one full runtime and secret store per identity, not one shared script.
